response: The Moon appears to change shape over the course of a month because Earth-facing observers see different amounts of the Moon's sunlit face as it orbits Earth. At new moon, the Earth-facing side is completely dark and invisible from Earth. As the Moon moves away from the Sun in its orbit, more of it gets illuminated and appears to grow into a crescent, half, and full moon, before shrinking back to a new moon. response: To compare two fractions, find a common denominator — the least common multiple of the denominators. Convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with this common denominator. Now the fractions will have the same denominator, so compare the numerators directly. The fraction with the larger numerator is larger. messages.content: Explain why a metal spoon can feel colder than a wooden one in the same room.

response: A metal spoon feels colder than a wooden one in the same room because metal has a much higher thermal conductivity and a higher thermal capacity. When you hold the spoon, your body heat quickly transfers to the metal, and because it can absorb and dissipate heat rapidly, the handle of the metal spoon can drop to near ambient temperature — or below — very fast. Wood, by contrast, has much lower thermal conductivity and slower heat transfer — your body heat has to penetrate deeper into the wood and less heat is lost to the air, so the wooden handle stays warmer longer. This difference in sensation is unrelated to air temperature and is purely a material property.
